description: Chat with nanobot from a Zalo personal account.

setup.tryIt: After QR login finishes, send a Zalo DM to the connected account.
setup.summary: Zalo signs in with a QR code using the unofficial zca-js personal-account API. Using Zalo automation may result in account suspension.
steps: Click Connect and scan the QR code with the Zalo app on your phone.
Keep the local gateway running while Zalo receives messages.
Send a direct test message to confirm the account is connected.

allowFrom.label: Allowed users
allowFrom.help: Leave empty to use pairing codes.

custom.scanDescription: Use the Zalo app on your phone to scan this code. nanobot saves the account session locally after login.
custom.expired: Zalo login expired. Scan again to reconnect.
custom.failed: Unable to connect Zalo. Try again.
